corpus: BugsInPy (soarsmu/BugsInPy mirror) - real historical tornado bugs
harness_laws: BugsInPy pairs BUGGY SOURCE with the FIXED TEST FILE (the failing test is added in the fix commit). Baseline red must be the REAL bug's symptom.
Satisfiability gate: an instance is valid only if applying the REAL fix greens the named test in our env (3.11). 2 candidate bugs discarded before this gate existed.
Wall-clock is part of the metric: repair within B seconds or NOT_REPAIRED_TIMEOUT.
